status: available VPS software-renderer measurements; physical Windows GPU qualification pending
method: Three matched fresh-profile pairs, baseline trials completed before final feature trials. Selected Balanced640x480, actual framebuffer dimensions in metadata (baseline1280x720 due existing startup fallback), seed748291, draw distance112, horizon2048, dynamic resolution off, scale1. Identical 810 resident-chunk preload plus ten graphics warm-up frames. Video inactive. CPU stage elapsed time can include driver waits. GPU frame metric is delayed EMA, not GPU percentiles.
